rules.condition: listed option quote is ordered and positive
rules.action: use ask for long entry, bid for short entry, bid for long exit, and ask for short exit
reject every candidate whose maximum loss is unknown or unbounded

rules.condition: a validation gate declares a minimum sample size
rules.action: return INSUFFICIENT_DATA when available observations are below the configured minimum

recipes.name: Long call, including long-dated maturity classes
assumptions: Standard listed equity-option contract semantics are verified before use.
Experimental search grids are not claimed to be profitable book rules.
conditions: Maximum loss is calculated and does not exceed the trade request.
Every leg is actually listed and passes the configured liquidity policy.
recipes.action: enumerate all listed combinations inside the declared search ranges
risks: Early assignment and pin risk require human review for short American options.
Leg-by-leg quotes do not establish a simultaneous combo fill.

validation_history.notes: Structural validity only; empirical edge remains NOT_TESTED.
